layout.how: the official template's own styles, numbering, margins and column setup are reused; nothing is re-specified by us
layout.pagination: none (template: 'Do not add any kind of pagination anywhere in the paper')

text.heading_numbers: removed from text; the template numbers heads (template: 'Do not number text heads')
text.paper_title_case: headline style per ESM 'Title' (nouns, pronouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, subordinating conjunctions and prepositions longer than three letters capitalized; articles, coordinating conjunctions, short prepositions lowercase unless first/last). 'most short prepositions' is not a closed list -> flagged
text.abstract_words: ESM: one paragraph, 150-250 words (Transactions rule; the conference template sets no length) -> advisory flag only

citations.order: numbered in order of first citation (template: 'Number citations consecutively within brackets')
citations.author_names_in_text: kept: removing them changes the author's sentence; flagged when not integral (ESM)
citations.in_reference_phrase: flagged, not rewritten (ESM: write 'in [1]', not 'in reference [1]')

references.authors: initials before surname; all names up to six; more than six -> first author + 'et al.' (Ref. Guide: General guidelines)
references.title: sentence case in quotation marks, comma inside the closing quote (Ref. Guide examples; template: 'Capitalize only the first word in a paper title, except for proper nouns')
journal_abbrev_order: titles abbreviated in the Reference Guide's own examples
word table 'Common Abbreviations of Words in References' (every word must map, else full title kept + flag)
references.months_source: Ref. Guide examples: all twelve abbreviations (Jan., Feb., Mar., Apr., May, Jun., Jul., Aug., Sep., Oct., Nov., Dec.) occur in the guide's own examples
references.pages: pp. first–last (en dash, full digits as in the guide examples)
references.article_number: Abbrev. month, year, Art. no. xxx
references.final_period: every reference ends with a period unless it ends with a URL
references.sheet_attested_note: These abbreviations are the ones checklist_ieee.md rule 28 verified for this sample against the IEEE abbreviation sheet. A journal in neither this list nor guide_attested_titles is left in full and flagged.
